hero.subtitle: Alfredo Zanetti is a Perth-based photographer shooting fashion campaigns, model portfolios and portraits with an editorial, documentary sensibility.

about.title:
Trained to read a room,
now trained on a lens.
paragraphs: Before picking up a camera, Alfredo Zanetti studied sociology — reading status, movement and tension in a room. That same instinct now shapes every campaign, portfolio and portrait he shoots across Perth.

The result is a body of work that feels observed rather than staged: clean, cinematographic images built around real posture and natural light, informed by street style and the everyday texture of the city.

services.title: Fashion Campaigns

faq.question: How far in advance should I book?
faq.answer: For campaigns and model portfolios, 2–3 weeks' notice is recommended to allow time for planning, location scouting and permits where needed.

faq.question: What's included in a shoot package?
faq.answer: Every package includes pre-shoot planning, the session itself and a set of fully edited, delivery-ready images. Exact deliverables are confirmed in your quote.

faq.question: Do you travel outside Perth?
faq.answer: Yes — shoots outside the metro area can be arranged, with travel costs quoted separately.

faq.question: What's the turnaround time for edited images?
faq.answer: Standard turnaround is 5–10 business days, depending on the size of the shoot.

faq.question: Do you require a deposit?
faq.answer: Yes, a deposit secures your date. The remaining balance is due on delivery of the final images.

footer.text: Fashion & portrait photography, based in Perth, Western Australia.
